rules: Academy graduates enter the service pool at Genin rank.
Aggregate promotions conserve bodies inside the same service pool and never create personnel.
Genin to Chunin throughput is deliberately lower than Academy graduation throughput over the long run.
Chunin to Jonin throughput is deliberately lower than Genin to Chunin throughput.
Exact named people are never auto-promoted by aggregate throughput; exact promotion requires career_status_resolution with institutional authority and evidence.
Promotion credits carry fractional expected throughput across reviews so rare Jonin promotion remains possible without forcing one every month.
